title: James Beveridge and Jean White — Brunswick marriage intention
access: Transcribed register entry
claim: The 1888 transcription lists James Beveridge and Jean White, both of Georgetown, as having entered an intention to marry on February 6, 1749.
limits: Marriage intention only; the marriage ceremony and identity of the couple with existing profiles are not proven. Compare the alternate 1895 transcription drawn from the same register.
rights: External archival transcription; open at host

title: Alternate reading: James Beviridge and Jean Write
access: Transcribed register entry
claim: The 1895 transcription reads 'James Beviridge and Jean Write, of Georgetown' and dates the entry February 6, 1748–9.
limits: Variant spellings in a second printing of the SAME underlying Brunswick register. These are not independent witnesses to a ceremony; no original manuscript scan linked.
rights: External archival transcription; open at host

title: Cyrus Eaton's 1865 family account — Matthew and Nathaniel
access: Free complete public-domain scanned Volume II, printed pp. 146–147
claim: Vol. II, pages 146–147, prints Matthew's family group and calls Nathaniel born c.1804 his nephew.
limits: Near-contemporary compiled local-family narrative, not birth, marriage or probate originals. The original printed book can be inspected freely; 'nephew' degree and identities still require primary records.
rights: 1865 edition is public domain (confirmed by Wikimedia Commons catalog); scan remains at holding archive

title: Nathaniel's proposed John White Beverage–Rachel Crosby parents
access: Secondary genealogy page
claim: A compiled tree assigns Nathaniel (born Oct. 20, 1803) to John White Beverage and Rachel Crosby and reports a Sarah Alexander marriage April 26, 1838.
limits: No original parentage document retrieved. If Matthew was Capt. Thomas's brother, this ancestry implies grandnephew rather than nephew. Treat as a hypothesis, not a new genealogy edge.
rights: External family-tree webpage; no image copied

title: Henry T. Beverage and Ella Allen — Maine marriage-index lead
access: FamilySearch profile containing record links
claim: FamilySearch indexes lead to a December 17, 1898 marriage in Rockland; the family history records Henry's birth and Nathaniel–Sarah parentage.
limits: Linked FamilySearch profile is a compiled landing page, not an original scanned register. The underlying 1898 marriage image is not verified.
rights: External records; availability may require a FamilySearch account

title: 1937 Calderwood diary — Frank and May's golden wedding
access: PDF transcript; references a photo caption
claim: Tonny Calderwood's October 15 entry records a golden-wedding celebration for Frank and May Beverage and a caption on a related photograph.
limits: Transcribed diary is not a verified original diary scan. The photograph itself was not obtained. The couple's identities and an 1887 wedding remain to be independently verified.
rights: Diaries and images are controlled by their owners; link only, no copied text or photo

title: 1967 Calderwood diary — correspondence with Samuel Beverage
access: PDF transcript
claim: The March and June 1967 diary entries report exchanging genealogical information with a Samuel or 'Sammy' Beverage.
limits: The Samuel mentioned has not been independently identified as the existing Samuel Hiram Beverage profile. Original letters are not yet in hand.
rights: Diaries and images controlled by owners; link only

title: 1975 recovery of Pulpit Harbor bridge bills, road map and deeds
access: Historical society page
claim: Lewis Haskell's recollection describes old deeds, road maps, first-bridge bills and other papers found at the dump by Sam Beverage and neighbors before the society's November 1975 founding meeting.
limits: The article describes the holdings; individual original documents, parcel boundaries, and current call numbers have not been inspected.
rights: External historical society website; obtain permission for images/scans

title: Historic Pulpit Harbor photographs, bridges and mill sites
access: Original exhibit with linked subject galleries
claim: Historical society exhibits describe Pulpit Harbor's former buildings, schools, mills, bridges and waterfront, alongside historical images.
limits: An exhibit/photo is not a land deed. Individual image provenance and reproduction rights must be checked before any family-site hosting.
rights: North Haven Historical Society; no photos copied

title: 1848 original law — North Haven Bridge Company
access: Contemporary legislation scanned as PDF
claim: Maine legislative act specifies the authorized bridge near land of James and Josiah Beverage at the head of Pulpit Harbor.
limits: Identifies landowners within a legislative route description, but does not give their deed chain, acreage or a surveyed parcel boundary.
rights: Government legislative PDF; link to original

title: Pulpit Harbor working waterfront and surviving cellar-hole traces
access: Illustrated history at holding organization
claim: North Haven Conservation Partners describes former roads, house sites, store, cooper shop, boat yards and ownership changes around Pulpit Harbor, with credited historical photos.
limits: Interpretive location history; do not infer precise ancestral title/lot dimensions from illustrated description.
rights: Photos credited to North Haven Historical Society; no reproduction without permission

title: Harold Beverage's 1930s Fox Islands film
access: Video page at North Haven Historical Society
claim: The society hosts period film made by Harold Beverage showing island life and neighboring communities.
limits: Exact frame subjects, dates and individuals have not been verified here. The website links to the publisher rather than copying the film.
rights: Rights held by the film source/publisher; no rehosting

title: North Haven Historical Society archives and scan-permission policy
access: Collection access and reproduction policy
claim: The archive offers research assistance and may scan original documents through staff, subject to collection conditions.
limits: This is an access policy, not evidence of any particular Beverage record being present or digitized.
rights: Check staff approval before scanning/republishing

title: 1883 Beach Bridge — town contract naming Alvin Beverage
type: Original document reproduced in historical exhibit
access: Illustrated PDF, original contract reproduced on PDF page 8
claim: The North Haven Historical Society exhibit reproduces a contract with Alvin Beverage concerning construction of Beach Bridge in 1883, and photographs the bridge in its original location.
limits: The PDF contains historical documents and captions, but we have not inspected the original physical instrument or established which genealogical Alvin was named. A bridge crossing is not a surveyed title boundary.
rights: Reproduced by North Haven Historical Society; permission required to republish scanned contract/photos

title: Historic town payment records — Alvin Beverage and Beach Bridge
type: Original historical bill reproduced in exhibit
access: Illustrated PDF, reproduced town bill(s) on PDF page 9
claim: The bridge exhibit reproduces records of payments in connection with Beach Bridge, including an early 1906 town payment record naming Alvin Beverage, alongside bridge construction photographs.
limits: Check the reproduced document's text before assigning an individual payment amount, exact date or signature. Do not assume these are title deeds or that 'Alvin' is a separately identified existing ancestor.
rights: Original document photo/reproduction controlled by holding archive; link only

title: Mill Stream exhibit — Thomas, James, Harrison, Hiram and Sam Beverage
access: 3-page PDF with photographs and map or sketch references
claim: The local history identifies Thomas Beverage as a grist-mill operator and son James as a tanner at Fresh Pond, reports Harrison Beverage purchasing the lower dam in 1888, and says Hiram Beverage worked at a mill in 1909 and built the 1932 dam.
limits: This modern history cites local historical accounts and a rescued sketch, not direct scans of all deed transfers. Harrison's precise identity and each property's chain of title need separate verification.
rights: North Haven Historical Society PDF; don't rehost photos or sketches without permission

title: North Haven Frank Beverage's 1954 signed birth statement
access: Digitized album account, with historical images
claim: Elizabeth Bean Calderwood Carter album transcription attributes a July 19, 1954 North Haven inscription to Frank Beverage; it records his self-reported birth date January 14, 1861 and age 93.
limits: Original signed leaf has not been physically examined. A Frank in a Thomaston cemetery listing with a 1939 date cannot be the same 1954 signer if both records are accurate.
rights: Third-party album images remain with source owner; link only

title: Thomaston cemetery: Frank Beverage plot card, Section 8 Lot 76
access: Searchable historic burial-card table
claim: Thomaston Village Cemetery Section 8 Lot 76 lists Frank Beverage with February 5, 1939, and lists several other individuals including Orra S. Roney.
limits: The table's Date field is not a verified death certificate. It does NOT prove this Frank is the North Haven man born January 14, 1861; the 1954 autograph conflicts strongly with that interpretation.
rights: Genealogy Trails cemetery transcription; no card photograph rehosted

title: 1911 Gazette: Orra Roney visits a Frank Beverage household on Green Street
access: Digitized contemporary newspaper PDF
claim: An August 1, 1911 notice says Mrs. Orra Roney and daughter Jeanette visited Mr. and Mrs. Frank Beverage on Green Street. Thomaston's Frank Beverage cemetery lot also records Orra S. Roney.
limits: A shared name and visitation support a research connection, not a proved kinship or identical householder. The newspaper excerpt does not by itself establish the municipality of Green Street.
rights: Digitized historical newspaper externally linked; no scan rehosted

title: Cyrus Eaton's original 1865 Volume II — complete scanned PDF
access: Downloadable original scan of the printed 1865 volume
claim: The original volume's printed pages 146–147 name Capt. Matthew's two wives and ten children and identify Nathaniel and Sarah Alexander as niece/nephew of Matthew.
limits: Published genealogy, not the original civil certificates. The printed pagination differs from PDF image index; open or search printed pp. 146–147.
rights: Public-domain book scan from Internet Archive, catalogued by Wikimedia Commons

title: Knox County historic deed books and 1860–1920 grantee/grantor indexes
access: FamilySearch catalog/index description, some images may require login
claim: The catalog describes Knox County deed records dated 1873–1917, indexes dated 1860–1920, and broader deeds dated 1791–1926; the reported 1888 Harrison purchase is within indexed coverage.
limits: A record collection exists, but NO Harrison 1888 deed or its book/page has yet been found and checked. Catalog lists are not proof a specific transaction occurred.
rights: Catalog metadata; original deed images are controlled by the registry or FamilySearch

title: Maine Registry of Deeds Association — official county-record portal
access: Original county records and document requests
claim: Maine's statewide official portal provides access to participating county deed registries, including Knox County, which is relevant to the reported 1888 Mill Stream parcel transfer.
limits: The online portal does not itself identify Harrison's deed or a historic lot. Original registry index and legal description must be searched and read before mapping property.
rights: External government registry portal; access terms apply

title: 1930 Courier-Gazette: Frank and May's 43rd wedding anniversary
access: Original October 18, 1930 newspaper PDF; North Haven column
claim: The North Haven column says Mr. and Mrs. Frank Beverage celebrated their 43rd wedding anniversary Wednesday evening, October 15, 1930. The 1937 Calderwood diary independently describes their 50th anniversary on the same date.
limits: Two anniversary reports corroborate the commemorated 1887-10-15 marriage date, but neither is the marriage return. Do not assign May's maiden name or merge the couple with one of the separate Frank Beverage identities without other records.
rights: Historical digitized newspaper linked at holding archive, not rehosted
